In mathematics, the '''Kallman–Rota inequality''', introduced by {{harvtxt|Kallman|Rota|1970}}, is a generalization of the [[Landau–Kolmogorov inequality]] to [[Banach spaces]].  It states that 
if ''A'' is the [[Lie algebra|infinitesimal generator]] of a one-parameter [[Contraction (operator theory)|contraction]] [[semigroup]] then

: <math> \|Af\|^2 \le 4\|f\|\|A^2f\|. </math>
